id.description: The unique identifier for the history event

stageId.description: The id of the interview stage for this event

title.description: The interview stage title for this event

enteredStageAt.description: The timestamp the application entered this stage

stageNumber.description: The order of the history event in the application's history. 0 is the first event.

allowedActions.description: Actions that can be performed on this history event via `application.updateHistory`.
